Seek Balance

Awake and in the Rhythm
with the Ocean Tides
Discover your Ultimate Getaway to Relaxation at Our Ventura Beach Hotel
IF YOU DREAM of being lulled to sleep by gentle surf, exploring tide pools on a private beach, and relaxing at poolside in a lush tropical garden setting, the Cliff House Inn, transforms these dreams into an affordable reality. Located just 15-minutes from downtown Santa Barbara, the special ambiance and signature service of this Ventura beach hotel keep guests returning and recommending the resort. The Cliff House Inn is also proud to host a restaurant recently voted as one of the most Romantic dining locales in the area, adding to the allure of this coastal retreat.
The Shoals Restaurant  showcases a delectable menu featuring an array of steaks and seafood, complemented by signature cocktails and an extensive selection of local wines. Whether you choose to dine by the pool, immersed in the serene outdoor ambiance, or in the intimate coziness of our dining room, each setting promises a unique culinary experience. Indulge in the finest flavors, expertly crafted cocktails, and the perfect pairing of local wines, making your meal at The Shoals an exquisite journey for your taste buds.
Looking for an ideal last-minute gift? Consider grabbing a Cliff House Inn gift card online . Receive a virtual gift card delivered via email within a few hours!
